name: The Raider Toll
description: Ash Raiders burned the palisade of the frontier outpost. The Drift Merchant pays for timber to rebuild it and for every raider driven off.
role: The first quest of the frontier: gather, fight and report back.

steps.description: Cut Rustbark logs for the new palisade.
Drive the Ash Raiders away from the outpost.

talk.text: Timber stacked and the raiders gone? Then the palisade stands by nightfall.
Take the credit and the gel. Harmony pays its debts, even out here.
